seo.description: Short term rental management worldwide, mainly US and Canada: we run your Airbnb, Vrbo and Booking.com listings remotely, with local partners for upkeep.

hero.heading: Your rental, run with care from listing to checkout
lead: Staylumen is a short-term rental management and co-hosting team that runs your listing, pricing and guest messages online.

blocks.heading: A Remote Management Company Built for Owners
paragraphs: We run your rental listing remotely and take the management work off your hands, handling short-term rental management and co-hosting for you. If you're comparing short term rental management companies, send us your property details for a [free, no-obligation earnings estimate and plan](/request-a-quote/), and we'll walk you through the revenue projection on a free 30-minute discovery call.

blocks.heading: Who We Work With and Where

items.heading: Ownership or authorization
paragraphs: We assess your property if you own it or are authorized to manage it, and local rules allow short-term rentals.

items.heading: Worldwide coverage, mainly the US and Canada
paragraphs: We take on properties worldwide, mainly in the United States and Canada. We don't take properties in places where short-term rentals are prohibited.

items.heading: Your preliminary checks
paragraphs: Before you apply, you confirm that your HOA rules and any lease or mortgage terms that apply allow short-term rentals.

items.heading: Our eligibility review
paragraphs: Before we accept your listing, we check the local short-term rental rules, including permit and licensed-manager requirements, and assess its revenue potential.

items.heading: Local revenue evidence
paragraphs: To judge your property's revenue outlook, we look at nightly rates, occupancy and seasonality for comparable local listings over the past 12 months.

items.heading: Experienced owner support
paragraphs: Our [online-only team](/about-us/) has more than 10 years of hosting experience and manages over 110 properties. We work directly with owners and hosts, and we don't sell or book stays for guests.

blocks.heading: Management Services on Every Major Platform
paragraphs: We set up and run your listings with you on Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com and other short-term rental platforms.
rows: Full management
If you want hands-off hosting, we manage your listing for 10% of rental revenue plus a USD 100 monthly software fee per listing.
Reservations-only

If you have a reliable local team for operations, you keep those responsibilities and pick services à la carte: master calendar management at USD 50 per listing per month and dynamic pricing at USD 75 per listing per month, both billed monthly in advance, with no management percentage or software fee.
Airbnb Co-Hosting
With [Airbnb Co-Hosting](/airbnb-co-hosting/), we optimize and reposition your live listings first, then manage them remotely.
Airbnb Listing Optimization & SEO

Our [Airbnb Listing Optimization & SEO](/airbnb-listing-optimization-seo/) service works on your visibility, search ranking and conversion. In our experience, making changes in phases keeps rankings steadier than changing everything at once.
Dynamic Pricing

With [Dynamic Pricing](/dynamic-pricing/), we review and adjust your rates by hand inside your accounts at least once a day, based on local demand 180 days ahead, events, competitors, market averages and your existing booking trends.
Airbnb Booking Management

Our [Airbnb Booking Management](/airbnb-booking-management/) service handles every reservation and answers guest messages 24/7, 365 days a year. You keep control of availability and can reserve personal dates that don't overlap existing bookings.

blocks.heading: Homes We Manage, From Studios to Estates

items.heading: Studios through villas
paragraphs: We manage everything from unique studios to luxury villas, including homes with swimming pools, hot tubs, pool tables, game rooms and movie theaters.

items.heading: Amenity-specific checks
paragraphs: We shape your operating plan around your property and add pool, hot tub and game-room checks to every turnover checklist.

items.heading: Luxury estate care
paragraphs: For luxury estates, we vet guests stringently, and partner crews carry out preventative maintenance at the property.

items.heading: Cabins and vacation homes
paragraphs: For cabins and vacation homes, including those in remote markets, we coordinate weatherproofing, seasonal logistics and consistent vendor quality.

items.heading: Second home readiness
paragraphs: We block your owner dates early, keep your second home ready for when you arrive and manage it so it earns income while you're away.

items.heading: Rental conversion support
paragraphs: Our [Airbnb Design & Furnishing](/airbnb-design-furnishing/) service supports your conversion all the way from choosing and furnishing the property through setup and ongoing management.

blocks.heading: Clear Fees With No Hidden Markups

items.heading: Consistent fee structure
paragraphs: Your full-management percentage is the same whatever your property or local market, and you pay no setup, onboarding or hidden charges.

items.heading: Defined revenue base
paragraphs: The management percentage applies to your nightly-rate and extra-guest revenue after platform host fees. Cleaning fees, taxes and security deposits are left out.

items.heading: Refunds and cancellations
paragraphs: Refunded amounts are left out, and cancellation payouts you keep under your policy are included. We work out the fee for each stay in the month of checkout.

items.heading: Included management work
paragraphs: Your management fee covers multi-platform marketing, cleaning coordination, guest care, local-partner support and listing compliance. When you compare managers, look at what's included and the revenue base, not just the headline percentage.

items.heading: Unmarked vendor bills
paragraphs: Local partners and other third-party vendors bill you directly. When we arrange their work, we add no markup on maintenance or vendor costs.

items.heading: Software and platform charges
paragraphs: Your full-management software fee covers pricing tools, market data and calendar software, so you buy no separate licenses. Platforms take their host and guest-payment-processing fees before payout, and those fees are not part of our invoice.

items.heading: No long-term commitment
paragraphs: Our [agreement arrangements](/faq/) run month to month with no long-term lock-in, and you can cancel with 30 days’ notice.

items.heading: Service remedy terms
paragraphs: Under our [service terms](/terms-and-conditions/), partner work that falls short is redone free or reassigned. We fix our own work within 2 business days. If you cancel, we complete the handover within 5 business days.

blocks.heading: Your Home, Cared For by Local Partners

items.heading: Coordinated local work
items.text: We arrange independent local partner companies for cleaning, key handover and maintenance. None of our own staff work at your property.

items.heading: Your existing team
items.text: If your on-site team is reliable and available for same-day turnovers, we keep them on. If not, we arrange a vetted local partner.

items.heading: Vacation Rental Cleaning
items.text: Through our [Vacation Rental Cleaning](/vacation-rental-cleaning/) service, we coordinate hotel-standard cleaning and sanitizing before and after stays, along with fresh linen, restocking and inspections between guests.

items.heading: Airbnb Property Maintenance
items.text: Through our [Airbnb Property Maintenance](/airbnb-property-maintenance/) service, we coordinate routine upkeep and on-call repairs with local vendors, including pools, hot tubs, lawns and outdoor areas.

blocks.heading: When There's No Partner Nearby
paragraphs: If there's no vetted partner near you, we coordinate your existing on-site team or find and vet a local company within 14 days. Every turnover is documented, and we keep a backup partner ready in each area. If a turnover is missed, we send another partner the same day and give you the records you need to claim losses from the company responsible. Partners are independent businesses, and they are liable for their own work, including any damage they cause.

blocks.heading: Costs Outside Our Fees
paragraphs: You pay for cleaning, inspections, repairs, restocking and other local jobs at your partners’ rates, within 7 days of each invoice. If you set your guest cleaning fee high enough to cover turnover invoices, that fee pays for the expense, and it reaches you with each booking. Short-term rental insurance, restocking and taxes need their own place in your budget. Permit, registration and tax payments go straight to the authorities, and you also pay for any optional add-ons you order, such as photography.

blocks.heading: Reporting, Payouts and Owner Support

items.heading: Your owner portal
paragraphs: Once you sign, we email you an invitation to your owner portal, where you get a real-time dashboard and calendars.

items.heading: Direct owner support
paragraphs: Your dedicated phone and text line means no waiting on hold. Calls are answered in business hours, urgent issues at an occupied property reach us 24/7, and email and group chat work too.

items.heading: Performance reporting
paragraphs: We start tracking performance as soon as the transition is finished, keep watching results continuously and send you monthly reports on KPIs, revenue and occupancy.

items.heading: Market context
paragraphs: We also share vacation rental market trends, so you can see your property's performance reports in the context of the wider market.

items.heading: Direct booking payouts
paragraphs: Platforms pay booking income straight into your own accounts on their normal payout schedules. We never hold your rental income.

items.heading: Monthly statement timing
paragraphs: We invoice full-management and software fees with your monthly statement by the 10th of the following month, and you pay within 7 days by ACH or card.

items.heading: Checkable statement records
paragraphs: Before you sign, you can ask for an anonymized sample statement showing revenue, fees, expenses and net payout. You can check each statement against platform reports and partner invoices, and any discrepancy you flag within 30 days is corrected on the next statement.

items.heading: Licensing and tax records
paragraphs: Through our [Short-Term Rental Licensing & Compliance](/short-term-rental-licensing-compliance/) service, we support permits in your name before launch and the listing numbers you're required to show. Where platforms don't remit taxes, you or your accountant file and pay them using the monthly documentation we include.

blocks.heading: Launching or Taking Over Your Listing
paragraphs: We launch your property with an optimized listing, a pricing strategy and guest experience systems already in place, and we give you a clear timeline for every stage of the handover. If you already have a listing, our takeover process links the performance review to listing improvements, guest experience upgrades and coordinated operations.

blocks.heading: A Seamless Handover Without Lost Bookings

items.heading: Listings stay live
items.text: During the handover, we join your existing listings as co-host, and they stay live throughout the transition.

items.heading: Existing bookings continue
items.text: Our structured onboarding moves your calendars, pricing and listing data across without disrupting reservations you already have or breaking booking continuity.

items.heading: Guest conversations continue
items.text: We pick up conversations already under way with no gap in messaging, which protects your reviews, response times and platform performance.

items.heading: Controlled account access
items.text: Under our [privacy arrangements](/privacy-policy/), our team uses password-free access that you can revoke. Data is restricted to management and never shared for marketing. Access is removed within 1 business day after the engagement ends, and copies are deleted within 30 days.

mainEntity.name: Can I engage you just to coordinate turnover cleaning while keeping listing management and guest communication with my current team?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. You can hire us just to coordinate turnover cleaning, and your current team keeps handling listing management and guest communication. We take care of all contact with local cleaning partners and pass on the schedules from your booking calendar along with your special requests.

mainEntity.name: How much should I charge for Airbnb cleaning?

acceptedAnswer.text: Under full management, we propose a guest cleaning fee that covers the partner's turnover invoice, including laundry and restocking. We compare it with similar listings nearby so the guest's total stays competitive. The fee goes live only after you approve it. We review it whenever the partner's rate changes, and at least every 6 months. Cleaning fees come to you with each booking payout and are excluded from the rental revenue we use to calculate our 10% management fee.

mainEntity.name: Can you coordinate turnovers through my existing property-management or cleaning app, or would I need to change systems?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, you don't need to change systems. We connect cleaning assignments to most major property-management platforms through a direct calendar link or your channel manager. If your cleaning app offers team or partner access, we work inside it. If it doesn't, we sync turnovers from your platform calendars.

mainEntity.name: If a guest reports a missed cleaning task at arrival, how quickly can your partners return to correct it?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cleaning partner comes back within 6–24 hours to redo the missed area, at no extra cost to you. If that partner can't return within that window, we send a different local partner to make the correction.

mainEntity.name: Which conditions, such as severe smoke residue, bodily fluids or pest contamination, are outside turnover-cleaning scope and require specialist treatment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Turnover cleaning doesn't cover severe smoke residue, blood or other bodily fluids beyond normal bathroom use, pest infestations, animal waste beyond routine pet hair, or any repair and restoration work. When our cleaning partners find any of these conditions, they photograph them. We then arrange a separate assessment by a licensed specialist, such as a biohazard, odor-remediation or pest-control company, and the specialist invoices you directly.

mainEntity.name: How do cleaners distinguish forgotten belongings from trash, and who handles storage and return of items found during a turnover?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our cleaning partners throw away only items that are clearly disposable, such as food leftovers, empty packaging and used toiletries. Anything that could have value, including clothing, chargers, documents and jewelry, gets photographed, bagged, labeled and kept as a found item. The partner stores it securely for 30 days. We contact the guest through the booking platform within 24 hours, and if they want the item back, we arrange shipping at their cost.

mainEntity.name: Can you handle laundry for a smaller property with no washer or dryer, or when its machines break down?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. When your property has no washer or dryer, we arrange for a local laundry partner to collect the used linens and bring back clean sets. For this off-site laundry service, you keep 3 full sets of linens and towels for each bed and bathroom. If your machines break down, we move that turnover to off-site laundry the same day and arrange the appliance repair through our maintenance partners.

mainEntity.name: What checkout-to-check-in window do you require for my property, including days when several of my units turn over at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: We need at least 4 hours between checkout and check-in for homes with up to 3 bedrooms, and 5 hours for larger homes. A standard 11 a.m. checkout with a 4 p.m. check-in meets both. When several of your units turn over on the same day, each unit gets its own partner crew, so the same window applies to every property.

blocks.heading: What Each Guest Turnover Covers
paragraphs: Every turnover covers the whole interior that guests use, plus the outdoor seating areas.

items.heading: Indoor rooms
items.text: Our partners clear out whatever the previous guests left behind and wipe down every surface, including living rooms, dining areas, entryways and game rooms.

items.heading: Patios and balconies
items.text: During the turnover, guest-use areas are swept, outdoor furniture is wiped down and the trash is emptied.

items.heading: Excluded spaces
items.text: Pools, hot tubs, lawns, garages and owner-locked storage aren't part of turnover cleaning. Our maintenance partners look after them instead.

blocks.heading: Your Cleaning Checklist, Surface Care and Products
paragraphs: We hand our partners your cleaning checklist, take out any tasks you handle separately and brief them on your surface-care rules, such as pH-neutral cleaner on natural stone or no bleach on specified fixtures. If you need fragrance-free or other specific products, partners use matching products from their kit. If you keep your preferred brand at the property, they use it at every clean.

blocks.heading: Photo Checks Before Every Guest Arrival

steps.heading: Document the clean
steps.text: After every turnover, our partner sends timestamped photos of each room and the restocked amenities, along with confirmation that the lock or lockbox works.

steps.heading: Review before arrival
steps.text: Our team checks the photos and access confirmation as soon as the partner sends them, before your next guest checks in, so we never rely on a reported finish.

steps.heading: Correct before check-in
steps.text: If anything is missing, the partner fixes it before check-in where the window allows, or returns within 6–24 hours at no extra cost; substandard work means a redo or a new partner.

items.text: Your local partner prices your turnovers on floor area, bedroom and bathroom counts, laundry load and the condition guests leave the place in.

items.heading: Additional cleaning charges
items.text: Off-site laundry, pet-hair removal, heavy soiling and deep-clean work at your property are charged as extras.

items.heading: Date and notice charges
items.text: Your cleaning partner also charges extra for holiday dates and for turnovers booked less than 24 hours ahead.

items.heading: Direct partner billing
items.text: The partner invoices you directly at its own rates. We add nothing, and payment is due within 7 days of the invoice date.

items.heading: Coordination included

items.heading: Guest fee offset

items.heading: Guest-ready staging
paragraphs: Our partners restock guest essentials and set up your unit to your written specifications. Reference photos help them match the home shown in your listing.

blocks.heading: Cleaning Supplies, Guest Amenities and Laundry

items.heading: Supplies and amenities
paragraphs: Our partners bring their own professional-grade cleaning supplies and equipment. You provide the guest amenities, including toilet paper and soap, from your property's own stock.

items.heading: Laundry arrangements
paragraphs: When your on-site machines can keep pace, we use them, and you need 2 complete linen and towel sets for each bed and bathroom. Larger homes and tight turnovers use off-site laundry, or rental where it's available. Off-site washing needs 3 sets.

items.heading: Off-site collection
paragraphs: At each turnover, our partner collects the soiled linens and towels and returns them within 24–48 hours. In the meantime, cleaners use the spare sets and spend less time on site.

items.heading: Local linen rental
paragraphs: Where a local laundry partner offers rental, we arrange for sheets and towels to be supplied, collected and laundered at each turnover. The partner invoices you directly.

items.heading: Owned linens and furnishing
paragraphs: With [Airbnb Design & Furnishing](/airbnb-design-furnishing/), our supply partner provides move-in kits with kitchen essentials, linens and towels that you own, along with amenities such as kitchenware, board games and pool toys.

items.heading: Your stock targets
paragraphs: Keep about 4 weeks' worth of guest amenities on hand, including toilet paper, soap and coffee. Tell us your preferred products and targets, such as 2 spare toilet paper rolls per bathroom.

items.heading: Stock checks and alerts
paragraphs: Partners count supplies as part of every turnover checklist. When an item drops below a 2-week supply, we let you know within 1 business day.

items.heading: Approved replenishment
paragraphs: Once you approve, we reorder your chosen products through our supply partner to bring stock back to target levels. Every 3 months, we go over the quantities with you and compare them with usage.

After the walkthrough, we either claim against the deposit or release it. Deposits are left out of the revenue we use to calculate our fee.

items.answer: Yes. You can hire us just to coordinate turnover cleaning, and your current team keeps handling listing management and guest communication. We take care of all contact with local cleaning partners and pass on the schedules from your booking calendar along with your special requests.

items.question: How much should I charge for Airbnb cleaning?
items.answer: Under full management, we propose a guest cleaning fee that covers the partner's turnover invoice, including laundry and restocking. We compare it with similar listings nearby so the guest's total stays competitive. The fee goes live only after you approve it. We review it whenever the partner's rate changes, and at least every 6 months. Cleaning fees come to you with each booking payout and are excluded from the rental revenue we use to calculate our 10% management fee.

items.question: Can you coordinate turnovers through my existing property-management or cleaning app, or would I need to change systems?
items.answer: No, you don't need to change systems. We connect cleaning assignments to most major property-management platforms through a direct calendar link or your channel manager. If your cleaning app offers team or partner access, we work inside it. If it doesn't, we sync turnovers from your platform calendars.

items.question: If a guest reports a missed cleaning task at arrival, how quickly can your partners return to correct it?
items.answer: The cleaning partner comes back within 6–24 hours to redo the missed area, at no extra cost to you. If that partner can't return within that window, we send a different local partner to make the correction.

items.question: Which conditions, such as severe smoke residue, bodily fluids or pest contamination, are outside turnover-cleaning scope and require specialist treatment?
items.answer: Turnover cleaning doesn't cover severe smoke residue, blood or other bodily fluids beyond normal bathroom use, pest infestations, animal waste beyond routine pet hair, or any repair and restoration work. When our cleaning partners find any of these conditions, they photograph them. We then arrange a separate assessment by a licensed specialist, such as a biohazard, odor-remediation or pest-control company, and the specialist invoices you directly.

items.question: How do cleaners distinguish forgotten belongings from trash, and who handles storage and return of items found during a turnover?
items.answer: Our cleaning partners throw away only items that are clearly disposable, such as food leftovers, empty packaging and used toiletries. Anything that could have value, including clothing, chargers, documents and jewelry, gets photographed, bagged, labeled and kept as a found item. The partner stores it securely for 30 days. We contact the guest through the booking platform within 24 hours, and if they want the item back, we arrange shipping at their cost.

items.question: Can you handle laundry for a smaller property with no washer or dryer, or when its machines break down?
items.answer: Yes. When your property has no washer or dryer, we arrange for a local laundry partner to collect the used linens and bring back clean sets. For this off-site laundry service, you keep 3 full sets of linens and towels for each bed and bathroom. If your machines break down, we move that turnover to off-site laundry the same day and arrange the appliance repair through our maintenance partners.

items.question: What checkout-to-check-in window do you require for my property, including days when several of my units turn over at once?
items.answer: We need at least 4 hours between checkout and check-in for homes with up to 3 bedrooms, and 5 hours for larger homes. A standard 11 a.m. checkout with a 4 p.m. check-in meets both. When several of your units turn over on the same day, each unit gets its own partner crew, so the same window applies to every property.

blocks.heading: Our Listing Optimization Service, Built on Real Search Data
paragraphs: We pick your listing’s search terms from real search data rather than guesswork. blocks.heading: Listing Content & Photo Optimization That Follows Airbnb's Rules

items.heading: Consistent property strengths
paragraphs: We build your title, description and captions around the photos and spaces that set your property apart, so every part of the listing describes the same strengths.

items.heading: Photo improvements
paragraphs: We reorder your existing photos, adjust only light, contrast and color, caption every image and point out any missing shots. An optional professional shoot fills those gaps and shows your rooms accurately.

items.heading: Publishing checks
paragraphs: We check your rewritten content and photos against Airbnb’s policies. Titles stay within 50 characters, and we leave out contact details, links, off-platform offers, discriminatory language and features the property doesn’t have. Any required permit numbers appear before launch.

items.heading: Availability checks
paragraphs: When your listing disappears from search, we look at blocked or unavailable dates, minimum-stay and trip-length restrictions, and whether the listing is snoozed or unpublished.

items.heading: Other search blockers
paragraphs: We also look for missing permit details, incomplete amenity fields and rates set far above comparable listings, so we can pin down what’s keeping your listing from being seen.

items.heading: Search recovery
paragraphs: We fix the issues we find within 5 business days, then track your position on fixed test searches every week until your listing shows up again.

items.heading: Experienced remote team
paragraphs: Our [remote team](/about-us/) manages over 110 properties and has more than 10 years of hosting experience. On a discovery call, we show you anonymized comparable results for the 12 months before and the 12 months after takeover, or since go-live if that’s shorter.

paragraphs: Most listings show measurable ranking gains within 2–4 weeks of optimization: in 2025, 9 of the 14 Airbnb listings we optimized did, measured as each listing's average position across a fixed set of guest searches, recorded weekly. How quickly yours moves depends on the platform, competing listings, your open dates and booking activity, so we judge results over several weeks of bookings, not the first few days after the changes go live.

blocks.heading: How We Track and Prove Your Ranking Gains

steps.heading: Define repeatable searches
steps.text: Before we edit anything, we set up searches for your area using three date ranges that stay the same each time, one guest count and two filter combinations.

steps.heading: Capture your baseline
steps.text: Before we change your listing, we record its starting search position, listing views, click-through rate and conversion rate.

steps.heading: Repeat weekly checks
steps.text: Every week, we run those searches while signed out, log each position and compare the results with the impressions and click-through figures in your Airbnb insights.

steps.heading: Verify genuine gains
steps.text: We count your ranking as improved only when your average position rises across the whole set of searches, never because of a single result.

steps.heading: Report and recommend
steps.text: Thirty days after optimization, we send you a before-and-after comparison based on your insights, along with recommended changes. From then on, your monthly reports include these metrics alongside occupancy and revenue.

lead: You set the budget and goals, and we take the home from empty rooms to guest-ready.

blocks.heading: Vacation Rental Furnishing From Competitive Analysis to Setup
paragraphs: We take care of your vacation rental furnishing as one complete job, starting with competitive analysis and moving through design to final setup. Your property, budget and goals shape a coordinated plan for furniture and amenities, so your spending goes toward the strongest possible return instead of isolated purchases.

items.detail: We build a furnishing plan and amenity choices that make your furniture spending go further, with a budget aimed at the strongest return.

items.detail: The home is furnished and set up, ready for guests.

blocks.heading: Getting Started: The Measurements and Walkthrough We Need
paragraphs: Since we design remotely, we need a floor plan or room-by-room measurements from you, along with a video walkthrough and the width of every doorway, hallway, stairway and elevator on the delivery route. Measure the whole route before design starts, not just the rooms. That includes tight stair turns, landings and elevator depth.

If anything is missing, we book a local partner to measure the home and confirm delivery clearances within 7 days, before anything is ordered. The partner bills you directly at its own rate. If you're unsure of your measurements, booking the partner means you aren't working from uncertain numbers. Measuring yourself saves that fee, but any mistake found on delivery day is yours: furniture that won't fit through becomes a return, a delay and a gap in the finished home.

blocks.heading: Review and Approve Your Design Board Before Anything Is Ordered
paragraphs: Nothing gets ordered until you've reviewed and approved the room designs, layouts and purchasing details. This is the cheapest moment to catch a problem, because once items are ordered, any change means returns, restocking and a later launch.

items.detail: Approve the board and layout and sign off on the itemized list in writing.

blocks.heading: What Shapes Your Airbnb Furnishing Cost

items.heading: Property size
items.text: The number of bedrooms and the square footage set how many pieces it takes to furnish your home.

items.heading: Finish selection
items.text: You choose from 3 finish tiers (essential, mid-range or premium), and that choice affects each room's cost more than anything else.

items.heading: Market fit
items.text: We match the tier to comparable nightly rates and what guests expect, not to personal taste. Finishes below premium cut your upfront and replacement costs but lose appeal with top-market guests.

items.heading: Customization and existing furniture
items.text: Once your tier is set, custom or made-to-order pieces raise the total, and keeping furniture you already own brings it down.

items.heading: Amenity extras
items.text: Furnishings for a pool, hot tub or game room add to the total on top of your finish tier.

items.heading: Written quote
items.text: We send a written quote within 3 business days of receiving your property details, itemizing these choices separately from our management fee.

items.heading: Supplier pricing
items.text: Furniture suppliers invoice you directly at their own prices, and we put no markup on those purchases.

items.heading: Listing photography
items.text: Through [Airbnb Listing Optimization & SEO](/airbnb-listing-optimization-seo/), we arrange an optional professional photo shoot.

blocks.heading: Interior Design Upgrades That Lift Occupancy and Nightly Rates

items.heading: Demand-led improvements
paragraphs: Before any money goes on furnishing, we look at local guest demand and recommend design and amenity changes that target higher occupancy and nightly rates, based on what guests expect and how they book.

items.heading: Amenities before décor
paragraphs: Pools, hot tubs and experience-driven spaces come first for us, because your money goes further on features guests search for and pay for than on décor alone.

items.heading: Upgrades and remodeling
paragraphs: We advise you on amenities, upgrades and repositioning. When the home needs interior design or remodeling work, we source certified designers, architects and licensed contractors through our partner network.

items.heading: Project timing
paragraphs: A full furnishing project takes about 6–8 weeks, depending on the size of the property, how much you customize and what's available. Customization, upgrades and remodeling make the project longer than furnishing the home as it stands.

items.heading: Rental conversion support
paragraphs: If you're converting a home into a short-term rental, we support you from choosing the property and furnishing it through setup and ongoing management.

items.heading: Our management role
paragraphs: We're a [short-term rental management and co-hosting company](/about-us/) that runs rental listings remotely for property owners.

blocks.heading: Guest-Proof Furniture, Safety Essentials and Amenities

items.heading: Guest-proof furniture
paragraphs: We pick durable, easy-to-clean pieces with stain-resistant finishes and fabrics that stand up to constant turnover, so you replace less between stays. The trade-off is that you get fewer delicate or statement designs than residential furniture offers.

items.heading: Tip-over-resistant storage
paragraphs: We select dressers and storage units that meet ASTM F2057 for tip-over resistance, to protect your guests.

items.heading: Bunk bed safety
paragraphs: The bunk beds we choose meet ASTM F1427, with guardrails on both sides of the top bunk and a fixed ladder. Guests under 6 don't use the top bunk.

items.heading: Anchoring and clear exits
paragraphs: Our delivery partners anchor tall furniture and wall-mounted TVs and keep a clear path at least 36 inches wide to every door and egress window, so no furniture blocks an exit.

items.heading: Smoke and carbon monoxide
paragraphs: Our local partners put smoke alarms in each bedroom and on every level. They add carbon monoxide alarms wherever the home has gas appliances or an attached garage.

items.heading: Emergency essentials
paragraphs: Every furnishing setup comes with at least one fire extinguisher in the kitchen and a stocked first-aid kit, installed by our local partners.

items.heading: Local safety requirements
paragraphs: Before setup, we check your city, state and platform rules for short-term rental safety and add any equipment they require, such as evacuation maps or extinguishers on each floor. This protects both your guests and your listing.

items.heading: Amenities and move-in kits
paragraphs: We stock kitchenware, board games and pool toys through a supply partner, and our move-in kits cover kitchen essentials, linens and towels.

blocks.heading: Smart Locks, Electronics and Streaming Setup

items.heading: Local installation
items.text: Our local partners install and set up smart locks, TVs, streaming devices such as Apple TV, routers with working internet, games, coffee makers, grills and other guest amenities.

items.heading: Existing device eligibility
items.text: We keep and configure your smart locks, routers and automation hubs only if their app supports remote code management and they still receive security updates. If they don't, we recommend replacing them.

items.heading: Secure guest access
items.text: A unique code for each guest and up-to-date firmware keep access secure and manageable, and nobody has to visit the property.

items.heading: Retained hardware trade-off
items.text: Keeping eligible devices saves you the cost of new hardware, but you give up the features and compatibility that newer devices offer.

items.heading: Lock fit checks
items.text: If a lock doesn't match your door, frame, latch bore, strike plate or deadbolt setup, we recommend replacing it. Before we start, we quote the hardware and any locksmith or handyman work it needs.

items.heading: Accounts and billing
items.text: Your device, internet, streaming and subscription accounts are in your name, with you as administrator. Sellers bill you directly, and we work through the access you grant us.

items.heading: Credential handover
items.text: Within 1 business day of setup, we send you every login and administrator credential for your devices and accounts.

items.heading: Access removal
items.text: When our engagement ends, we remove our own access to your devices within 1 business day.

blocks.heading: White Glove Delivery, Assembly and Final Walkthrough

steps.heading: Source and deliver
steps.text: Our white glove service takes care of sourcing, shipping and delivering all furniture and amenities to your home. Furniture usually arrives within 2-3 weeks; we chase any supplier delay and tell you.

steps.heading: Inspect and assemble
steps.text: When items arrive, our delivery partners inspect every one and photograph any damage. Then they assemble everything and clean up afterwards.

steps.heading: Resolve supplier claims
steps.text: We handle returns, replacements and warranty claims, including defects that show up after installation within the supplier’s warranty period. The purchases, warranties and refunds stay yours, and we send you the claim records within 2 business days of filing.

steps.heading: Test the home
steps.text: Once assembly is done, our local partner tests every item against the itemized list you approved, including lock codes, Wi-Fi, TVs, appliances and alarms.

steps.heading: Report and accept
steps.text: Within 2 business days of the walkthrough, we send you dated photos of every room, the checked-off item list and the open issues with their fix dates. You accept the home once those issues are closed.

steps.heading: Open your calendar
steps.text: You open your calendar after the walkthrough, once the issues are closed. Waiting means your first booking comes later than if you opened on delivery. But missing items, dead TVs and faulty codes lead to early reviews, and those hurt new listings most.

mainEntity.name: Does my minimum nightly rate remain protected after platform promotions and length-of-stay discounts are applied?

mainEntity.name: Can you coordinate pricing across similar units in my portfolio so they do not unnecessarily undercut one another?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We use one shared demand calendar, stagger discounts and keep a set rate gap between similar units. For example, in a given week we lower the price on only the unit with the most open nights, so your properties don't compete for the same guest.

mainEntity.name: How do you detect and correct pricing updates that fail to reach a booking platform, and what rates remain active during an outage?

acceptedAnswer.text: We check that your daily pricing updates reach each platform, and we fix any that fail. items.heading: Discount caps
items.text: You set a cap on discounts, such as no more than 20% off for last-minute dates or gaps between bookings.

items.heading: Daily adjustments
items.text: We fine-tune your rates and minimum stays every day and keep both within the boundaries you've agreed.

items.heading: Whole-stay pricing
items.text: We factor in cleaning fees and judge prices by the full amount your guest pays, not just the nightly rate.

items.heading: Manager-led changes
items.text: You can message your revenue manager to change your settings at any time, and we put the update in place within 1 business day.

items.heading: Fixed date overrides
items.text: You can fix the prices for particular dates, or edit them yourself and let us know. We lock those overrides until you ask us to lift them.

blocks.heading: Daily Rates Shaped by Market Data and Human Judgment

items.heading: Demand-led rates
paragraphs: We look at demand, seasonality and where your property sits in its market. The pricing tool is one input, not the final decision-maker.

items.heading: Local comparable properties
paragraphs: We pick 10 to 15 active listings with the same bedroom count as yours, either within 3 miles of your property or in the same resort area.

items.heading: Relevant guest alternatives
paragraphs: Your comparable listings sleep within 2 guests of your capacity, have similar review scores and share key amenities such as a pool, hot tub or parking.

items.heading: Refreshed comparisons
paragraphs: Every 90 days we refresh your comparable set. We take out inactive listings and properties that no longer match your quality level.

items.heading: Event-driven demand
paragraphs: We track local events, concerts and holidays. When demand jumps around major marathons or festivals, we raise your rates.

items.heading: Unusual data checks
paragraphs: Before an unusual demand signal affects your price, our team reviews it by hand. That brings local context into decisions the algorithm can't make alone.

blocks.heading: Minimum Stays and Gap Nights Set to Fill Your Calendar

items.heading: Connected calendar rules
items.text: We set your booking windows, minimum stays and gap-night rules together to balance longer bookings, occupancy and weekend demand.

items.heading: Advance booking restrictions
items.text: For dates far in advance, we restrict short stays so those dates stay open for longer reservations.

items.heading: Short-notice availability
items.text: As the arrival date gets closer, we drop the advance-booking restrictions and open shorter stays to last-minute bookings.

items.heading: Orphan night discounts
items.text: We lower prices for one- or two-night gaps only when cleaning can be scheduled before and after the stay.

items.heading: Weekly and monthly discounts
items.text: We set platform discounts of 5–15% for stays of 7 nights or more and 15–30% for stays of 28 nights or more.

items.heading: Peak-date protection
items.text: On peak and event dates, we reduce or switch off long-stay discounts to protect what those dates earn.

items.heading: Long-stay payout test
items.text: We accept a discounted longer stay when its payout is higher than the forecast earnings from shorter bookings on those dates. That payout counts both the discount and the turnovers you save.

items.heading: Cleaning capacity limits
items.text: When your cleaners can't attend, we block check-ins. We also raise minimum stays to cap weekly turnovers at a number we agree with you, for example 3.

blocks.heading: Ongoing Reviews and Plain-Language Reporting
paragraphs: Your named revenue manager reports to you directly and in plain language. In regular performance reviews, we explain what we changed, why we changed it and what the results show, so you understand the reasoning behind your pricing and calendar decisions.

items.question: Which pricing tools, property management systems and channel managers can you work with without requiring me to switch systems?
items.answer: We work with whichever pricing tool, property management system or channel manager you already use, so you don't have to switch. You add us to your Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com and other platform accounts through their co-host or team-access features.

items.question: Does my minimum nightly rate remain protected after platform promotions and length-of-stay discounts are applied?
items.answer: Yes. Your floor is the minimum you receive per night after promotions, last-minute deals and weekly or monthly discounts, and that includes low season. Before we turn on a discount, we check the nightly rate it produces. If a discount would take you below your floor, we reduce it or turn it off.

items.question: Do you adjust rates separately across booking platforms to account for their different commissions and protect my net earnings?
items.answer: Yes, where the platform's rules allow it. On channels with higher commissions, we raise your rates by the commission amount so your net earnings per night stay level across channels. Every month we check those markups against current host fees, and every channel stays at or above your floor.

items.question: Can you coordinate pricing across similar units in my portfolio so they do not unnecessarily undercut one another?
items.answer: Yes. We use one shared demand calendar, stagger discounts and keep a set rate gap between similar units. For example, in a given week we lower the price on only the unit with the most open nights, so your properties don't compete for the same guest.

items.question: How do you detect and correct pricing updates that fail to reach a booking platform, and what rates remain active during an outage?
items.answer: We check that your daily pricing updates reach each platform, and we fix any that fail. During a pricing-tool or channel outage, each platform keeps the last rates it successfully received, within your floor and ceiling. We pause automatic changes until the connection is back and we've checked it.

items.question: What do you need from me to keep the pricing working, and what happens if I change prices myself in the platform?
items.answer: Keep our team access active and tell us about planned works. Block your personal dates yourself or tell us about them, and aim to give us at least 14 days' notice. If you edit prices yourself, your changes stay live until our next daily update, which replaces any edits on unlocked dates. Tell us within 24 hours and we'll lock the date or adjust your floor and ceiling.

mainEntity.name: Can you manage linked calendars if I rent out individual rooms and the whole property as separate listings?

mainEntity.name: If an urgent guest problem needs someone on site and the local partner isn't available, what do I or my local contact have to do?

mainEntity.name: Can I set spending limits so you need my approval before offering refunds, discounts or other guest compensation?

If your limit covers routine complaints, we settle those complaints on the spot. Refunds required by your listing's cancellation policy or by a platform decision go through without prior approval.

blocks.heading: Booking Management Only or Full Management: What's Included
rows: Booking management fit
Booking management only is the right fit when you live close by and already have cleaners and maintenance people you can rely on.
Booking management scope

We handle inquiries, guest screening, reservations, guest messages and reviews inside your own platform accounts. Master calendar management and dynamic pricing are optional services you choose one by one, and adding dynamic pricing means giving us the access to change your rates.
What stays with you

You arrange and pay for cleaning and maintenance. You also look after key handover, restocking, damage follow-up and on-site help when a guest has an urgent problem, and you set your own rates if you don't choose dynamic pricing.
Full management

If you want the property to run without you being involved day to day, full management adds pricing, calendar control, listing optimization, damage claims, and permit and tax support. It also covers coordinating local partners for cleaning, key handover and maintenance.
Fees and transition

Your existing bookings stay in place with any of our [management options and onboarding](/). Full management costs 10% of rental revenue plus USD 100 a month in software fees per listing. We invoice it with your monthly statement, and you pay within 7 days by ACH or card. Reservations-only services are chosen à la carte, including master calendar management at USD 50 per listing per month and dynamic pricing at USD 75 per listing per month. These are billed monthly in advance, with no 10% management fee and no monthly software fee.
Dynamic pricing

With [Dynamic Pricing](/dynamic-pricing/), we check and adjust your nightly rates by hand in your accounts at least once a day. We base each change on local demand data for the next 180 days, market comparisons and your listing's booking trends.

mainEntity.name: Can I hire you just to coordinate maintenance, or does it come only with full management?

acceptedAnswer.text: Maintenance coordination is only available as part of our full management service. We don't offer it separately. Full management also takes care of your listing, pricing, guest support and cleaning, and local partners we arrange do all the on-site work. If you choose our reservations-only option, you handle cleaning and maintenance yourself.

mainEntity.name: If a repair takes several days, how do you fit it around my bookings, and will you block dates on the calendar?

acceptedAnswer.text: We first try to fit multi-day repairs into open gaps between stays, and we block extra dates only once you approve. When a job needs more nights than a gap allows, we propose dates for your approval before we block your master calendar. If the repair can wait, we send that proposal at least 7 days ahead. We never block dates that overlap a confirmed booking. The dates reopen the same day the partner confirms the work is finished. When parts delay the fix, a local partner we arrange makes a temporary repair. That could mean isolating and drying out a leak, bringing in portable AC or fans, or fitting a temporary lock. We order the parts on the supplier's fastest delivery and chase any delay, keeping you informed.

mainEntity.name: What will drive my maintenance costs up or down with you, beyond the management fee?

acceptedAnswer.text: Your costs go up with a larger or older property, with a pool or hot tub that needs weekly service, and with more frequent preventive checks (monthly instead of quarterly). Emergency callouts outside normal hours are billed at partners' after-hours rates, and partners in remote markets charge for their travel time. A newer home, fewer high-upkeep amenities and less frequent checks bring your costs down. Local partners bill you directly at their own rates, and we add no markup. Our 10% management fee stays the same no matter how much maintenance your property needs.

mainEntity.name: If the AC fails or there's a leak mid-stay, how do you handle refunds or relocating the guest, and do you check with me first?

acceptedAnswer.text: We approve goodwill refunds of up to USD 200 per reservation without asking you, and the amount is deducted from that booking's payout. A larger refund needs your written approval first. Moving the guest to another nearby stay at your cost also needs your written approval first.

mainEntity.name: How do you arrange authorized contractor entry while guests are staying and prevent continued access after the job?

acceptedAnswer.text: We arrange the visit with your guest and give the contractor temporary access for that job only, not ongoing access to your property. When the work is done, we remove that access. We also keep an entry record so you can see who went in and when.

paragraphs: We coordinate both one-off repairs and ongoing Airbnb property maintenance through local partners, and we handle every repair job on your behalf. paragraphs: We approve routine repairs up to USD 300 per job. For anything above that, partners wait for your written approval. If an emergency threatens safety or causes ongoing damage and we can't reach you, we authorize up to USD 1,000 and notify you within 1 hour.

blocks.heading: Preventive Maintenance and Turnover Inspections
paragraphs: Our partners inspect your property at every turnover. They also check the major systems separately on a fixed preventive schedule.

items.heading: Monthly checks
paragraphs: Each month, partners test the smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, check the fire extinguishers and replace HVAC filters as needed.

items.heading: Quarterly checks
paragraphs: Every quarter, as part of your preventive maintenance schedule, partners test every appliance, the GFCI outlets, the smart locks and the thermostats.

items.heading: Seasonal servicing
paragraphs: Twice a year, before the cooling and heating seasons, partners arrange full HVAC servicing. They also check the water heater, roof, gutters and any pool or hot tub equipment.

items.heading: Turnover damage checks
paragraphs: At every turnover, partners look over your walls, floors, furniture, fixtures and outdoor areas for damage and leaks.

items.heading: Turnover functional tests
paragraphs: Partners test the lights, locks and smart locks, smoke and carbon monoxide alarms, thermostat and HVAC, hot water, every appliance, the TV and the Wi-Fi.

items.heading: Specialist follow-up
paragraphs: If partners find a problem inside an HVAC unit, electrical panel, gas appliance, water heater or pool and hot tub equipment, we book a separate visit from a licensed specialist.

items.heading: Inspection reports
paragraphs: Within 24 hours of each visit, we send you the condition of every item checked, with dated photos and recommended repairs. This covers filters, thermostats, detectors, appliances, plumbing and smart locks.

items.heading: Maintenance history
paragraphs: We log every inspection and repair with its date, partner and invoice. You can ask for the full log anytime or review each month's entries alongside your statement.

blocks.heading: 24/7 Emergency Repair Response During Guest Stays
paragraphs: We coordinate emergencies 24/7 and handle guest communication while repairs are underway.

items.heading: Immediate callouts
paragraphs: A safety threat, ongoing damage or an unusable property means we send a partner out immediately. That includes active leaks, loss of heat or AC, power outages and lockouts.

items.heading: Habitability response
paragraphs: For urgent leaks, AC failures and lockouts, we aim to have a local partner there within 4 hours, and if none can attend, we book another local vendor.

items.heading: Minor faults
paragraphs: Anything outside those emergency conditions is booked for repair within 3 business days or at the next turnover.

items.heading: Payment timing
paragraphs: You don't fund a reserve or pay an advance deposit to us. Your maintenance invoices are payable within 7 days.

items.heading: Access preparation
paragraphs: Before go-live, send us your property access details and any existing cleaning or maintenance contacts so we can coordinate entry.

items.heading: Technical preparation
paragraphs: Also before go-live, send us the locations of the water, gas and electrical shutoffs and your appliance warranty details, so partners can start without delay.

items.heading: Damage claims
paragraphs: With [Airbnb Booking Management](/airbnb-booking-management/), we file platform claims within 14 days of checkout using walkthrough photos and invoices, and we submit 1 appeal if a claim is denied. We also provide the claim file for your insurer, but we don't cover denied amounts.

items.question: Can I hire you just to coordinate maintenance, or does it come only with full management?
items.answer: Maintenance coordination is only available as part of our full management service. We don't offer it separately. Full management also takes care of your listing, pricing, guest support and cleaning, and local partners we arrange do all the on-site work. If you choose our reservations-only option, you handle cleaning and maintenance yourself.

items.question: If a repair takes several days, how do you fit it around my bookings, and will you block dates on the calendar?
items.answer: We first try to fit multi-day repairs into open gaps between stays, and we block extra dates only once you approve. When a job needs more nights than a gap allows, we propose dates for your approval before we block your master calendar. If the repair can wait, we send that proposal at least 7 days ahead. We never block dates that overlap a confirmed booking. The dates reopen the same day the partner confirms the work is finished. When parts delay the fix, a local partner we arrange makes a temporary repair. That could mean isolating and drying out a leak, bringing in portable AC or fans, or fitting a temporary lock. We order the parts on the supplier's fastest delivery and chase any delay, keeping you informed.

items.question: What will drive my maintenance costs up or down with you, beyond the management fee?
items.answer: Your costs go up with a larger or older property, with a pool or hot tub that needs weekly service, and with more frequent preventive checks (monthly instead of quarterly). Emergency callouts outside normal hours are billed at partners' after-hours rates, and partners in remote markets charge for their travel time. A newer home, fewer high-upkeep amenities and less frequent checks bring your costs down. Local partners bill you directly at their own rates, and we add no markup. Our 10% management fee stays the same no matter how much maintenance your property needs.

items.question: If the AC fails or there's a leak mid-stay, how do you handle refunds or relocating the guest, and do you check with me first?
items.answer: We approve goodwill refunds of up to USD 200 per reservation without asking you, and the amount is deducted from that booking's payout. A larger refund needs your written approval first. Moving the guest to another nearby stay at your cost also needs your written approval first.

items.question: How do you arrange authorized contractor entry while guests are staying and prevent continued access after the job?
items.answer: We arrange the visit with your guest and give the contractor temporary access for that job only, not ongoing access to your property. When the work is done, we remove that access. We also keep an entry record so you can see who went in and when.

blocks.heading: Short-Term Rental Compliance Is the Groundwork for Every Listing
paragraphs: Whether we can manage your home as a short-term rental comes down to your local zoning and ordinances. That's why our short-term rental compliance service brings together two dedicated teams for you: research and compliance. Whether you already own a home or are thinking about buying one, our researchers study the rules that govern Airbnb and other short-term rentals and point you to the resources you need to check permitted use and the regulations that apply.

blocks.heading: A Written Eligibility Summary Before You Make an Offer
paragraphs: Before you make an offer, we give you a written eligibility summary for that specific address. That way, your purchase decision rests on the requirements that apply to that property, not on the city's general rules.

items.label: We reply to your enquiry
items.detail: We reply within one business day.

items.label: Receive your eligibility summary
items.detail: Within 3 business days of getting the address: zoning and ordinance status, permit, registration or licensed-manager requirements, night caps or minimum stays, occupancy taxes, and links to the official sources.

items.label: Make your offer
items.detail: Decide on your offer with the address-specific summary in hand.

blocks.heading: Our Research Team Settles Unclear or Conflicting Local Rules
paragraphs: When zoning and licensing rules are unclear or conflict, we ask the local planning or licensing office for a written answer before we advise you to go ahead, and we add its response to your eligibility summary. Until the point is clarified, we treat the requirement as unresolved. If no clear answer comes back within 10 business days, we mark it unresolved and don't recommend proceeding on it. We don't substitute our own interpretation for the authority's answer.

blocks.heading: HOA, Deed and Lease Restrictions Reviewed Before You List
paragraphs: Early in due diligence, we ask you to send your HOA or condo bylaws, CC&Rs, the deed and, if the property is rented, the lease. With those documents in hand, we review private restrictions alongside city rules, including bans on short-term stays, minimum lease terms and rental caps. Your summary flags any point that needs written HOA or landlord approval before you list.

blocks.heading: Your Options When Permits Are Capped or Limited
paragraphs: If your city allows short-term rentals only in owner-occupied homes, or caps the number of permits, we look at stays of 30 nights or more on the same platforms. Most short-term rental rules cover stays under 30 days, and we confirm the requirements for your address before you commit. You have other options too. You can host while you live in the home as your primary residence. You can join the city's permit waitlist where there is one. If you're still buying, you can compare nearby areas where permits are available.

blocks.heading: The Compliance Team Keeps Your Licenses, Permits and Registrations Current

items.heading: Expiry alerts
paragraphs: Every permit, license and registration expiry date goes into our compliance calendar. We email you 90 days before each deadline, then send reminders at 60 and 30 days that list any missing documents, inspections or fees.

items.heading: Renewal filing
paragraphs: We prepare and file your renewal forms, help you submit them at least 30 days before expiry, and follow the application until the renewed permit is issued.

items.heading: Documents and access
paragraphs: You send us your current permit, proof of short-term rental insurance, any ownership or ID documents we ask for, and access to the licensing portal, or a delegate login where the portal offers one.

items.heading: Signatures and fees
paragraphs: Where an agent is allowed to file, you give us signed authorization. You sign any documents the permit holder must sign personally, attend owner interviews, and pay license and permit fees directly to the authority.

items.heading: Lapsed or rejected applications
paragraphs: We take over the renewal or reapplication, ask the issuing office why it refused or what reinstatement requires, prepare a corrected application and follow it through to approval.

items.heading: Open violations
paragraphs: We help you resolve the cited problems, request any required re-inspections and draft your written response. Our local partners carry out the required inspections, repairs and corrections at the property.

items.heading: Recovery timing and bookings
paragraphs: Within 1 business day, we tell you what the authority needs. Our target is to resubmit within 10 business days of receiving your documents, and we block new bookings for any dates not covered by a license.

items.heading: Repair approval limits
paragraphs: When an inspection item fails, we coordinate [repairs and re-inspection](/airbnb-property-maintenance/) through vetted local partners. We can approve up to USD 300 per job without asking you, and anything above that needs your written approval.

blocks.heading: Staying Informed and Ready When Local Rules Change

steps.heading: Check local changes
steps.text: At least once a month, our compliance team checks ordinances, council agendas and licensing notices in every jurisdiction where we manage your property.

steps.heading: Notify you directly
steps.text: When a change affects you, we email you its details and effective date within 5 business days. You don't need to forward us a notice first.

steps.heading: Assign required actions
steps.text: Within 10 business days, or sooner if the effective date is closer, we send you a written plan for your property. It sets out the required changes, the authority's deadlines and who handles each one: you, our team or a local partner.

steps.heading: Track each completion

steps.heading: Identify affected stays
steps.text: Within 5 business days of the effective date being announced, we list every confirmed booking that the new rule makes noncompliant.

steps.heading: Carry out your decisions
steps.text: You decide on changes, moves, cancellations and refunds. We then adjust guest counts or dates, offer guests alternative dates or cancel through the platform's resolution process. We handle the platform communications and keep guests informed.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Do i need a license for airbnb?
items.answer: Whether you need a short-term rental permit, license, registration or occupancy tax account depends on your exact address. Many US cities and counties require them, and some areas require none. We check what applies to you and help you get the necessary permissions in place before go-live.

items.question: Can I use your ordinance research or compliance help before, or without, signing a management agreement, and is there a charge for it?
items.answer: You can get our eligibility research for any address in the United States or Canada before you sign a management agreement, or without signing one at all, with no charge or obligation. Ongoing compliance support comes with a management agreement: applications, renewals and tax documentation are part of the management fee at no extra charge. You pay permit, registration and tax amounts set by the authority directly.

items.question: Does your assessment include a legal opinion, or would I need separate counsel before relying on it for a property purchase?
items.answer: Our assessment is compliance research, not a legal opinion, and we are not a law firm. Before you rely on it for a purchase, you need a local real estate attorney to review the zoning, HOA, deed and title points. We send you and your attorney the written summary, the supporting ordinance sections and our correspondence with the authority.

items.question: I already hold permits from my previous manager. Can you take them over, check they're valid and sort out any that have lapsed?
items.answer: Yes. During onboarding, we check your existing licenses, permits and registrations against the authority's records, including their status, expiry and the name on file, and we check whether a licensed manager is required. Where it's necessary, we help you renew lapsed permissions or reapply in your name. Your listing stays unpublished until every required permission is in place.

items.question: Who bears penalties or other losses if a renewal deadline is missed because your team fails to complete an agreed task?
items.answer: If we miss a task that your management agreement assigns to us, we pay the resulting late fees or penalties and file the catch-up renewal at no extra charge. If a signature, document or payment assigned to you is late, those costs stay with you. When you report an error in our work, we fix it within 2 business days. This commitment covers late fees and penalties, not other losses.

items.question: Can you help respond to a violation notice, fine or license suspension, and where does your support stop and legal representation become necessary?
items.answer: Yes. Forward us the notice, and within 2 business days we review it against your listing and booking records, gather evidence, draft a response or corrective plan for you to sign and arrange the local fixes. Our support covers the paperwork, evidence and coordination. Hearings, appeals, disputed penalties and suspension proceedings require a local attorney, and we brief them with our records.

items.question: Will I have access to a property-level record of submitted applications, issued permits, expiration dates and outstanding compliance actions?
items.answer: Yes. You can see your property's compliance record at any time, with submitted applications, issued permits, registration numbers, expiration dates, outstanding actions and copies of documents. We also send you an updated copy with your monthly statement.

blocks.heading: Who We Are and How We Work Remotely
paragraphs: We manage your rental listing remotely, inside your own platform accounts, and we don't keep any staff of our own at your property. Our short-term rental management and co-hosting service looks after your listing, pricing, calendar, guest messages and reviews, and our team does all of it online. For cleaning, key handover and maintenance at your property, we arrange and coordinate local partner companies. You decide the pet policy, and when you need it, we arrange extra cleaning or maintenance plans to support it.

blocks.heading: What Are Your Contract, Insurance and Cancellation Terms?

items.heading: Contract and cancellation
items.text: We work month to month, with no long-term lock-in. You can cancel with 30 days’ notice, and there's no cancellation fee.

items.heading: Your property insurance
items.text: Before go-live, send us your property insurance policy. It has to explicitly cover short-term rental use with paying guests, and you need to keep it active for as long as we work together.

items.heading: Homeowner policy exclusions
items.text: If your homeowner policy excludes paying guests, you're exposed from the very first booking, and that policy doesn't meet our insurance requirement.

items.heading: Insured local partners
items.text: Every cleaning and maintenance partner we arrange has to carry its own insurance. We check that insurance, along with any required trade license, before their first job.

items.heading: Final management fee
items.text: After your end date, we invoice our 10% fee only on stays that have checked out by that date. Stays that check out later carry no fee from us.

items.heading: Final software charge
items.text: Your closing charges also include the monthly software fee per listing for the final month.

items.heading: Final statement payment
items.text: We send your final statement by the 10th of the following month, and payment is due within 7 days by ACH or card.

items.heading: Taxes on services
items.text: Our quoted management fee and service prices don't include taxes. If your state taxes these fees, we add sales tax as a separate line on your monthly invoice.

blocks.heading: How Soon Can My Home Go Live and Take Bookings?
paragraphs: Your home goes live within 7–14 days and starts taking bookings once onboarding is complete. Signing up takes less than 15 minutes.

Full optimization usually takes 30 to 90 days, as it did for 9 of the 14 Airbnb listings in our 2025 [listing optimization](/airbnb-listing-optimization-seo/) work. That time lets your new listing gain visibility, collect reviews and build momentum on the platforms. Treat those first months as a ramp-up period, and judge results once that foundation is in place. Without review history or ranking, early occupancy and rates understate what your home earns once the platforms show it more often.

blocks.heading: When San Diego Demand Peaks, From Summer Beaches to Comic-Con
paragraphs: July and August are San Diego’s [busiest visitor months](https://sdtmd.org/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/SDTMD_Report-Of-Activities_FY2026.pdf). Summer beach trips and Comic-Con push your occupancy and nightly rates to their highest of the year. We load premium rates before summer bookings open, then adjust them to booking pace, because early bookers snap up any peak night left at an ordinary rate, below what it would earn later.

Comic-Con is one of San Diego’s biggest booking events: when the city announced it would stay through 2030, it expected [more than 61,000 hotel room nights](https://www.sandiego.gov/mayor/mayor-gloria-announces-comic-con-will-remain-san-diego-through-2030) to be booked over the convention. Each year we confirm the dates, price those nights apart from the rest of July and set minimum stays to match the convention’s length. Once hotels fill, attendees turn to rentals; general summer pricing undervalues those nights, and short stays break up your most valuable stretch.

items.text: If you host a short-term rental in a home you don't own, you need a [Business Tax Certificate](https://www.sandiego.gov/treasurer/short-term-residential-occupancy), and you pay Business Tax every year.

items.heading: Taxable stay length
items.text: In the City of San Diego, short-term rentals of less than one month are subject to [Transient Occupancy Tax](https://www.sandiego.gov/treasurer/taxesfees/tot).

items.heading: Zone-specific tax rates
items.text: Since May 1, 2025, Transient Occupancy Tax has been [11.75%, 12.75% or 13.75%](https://www.sandiego.gov/treasurer/taxesfees/tot), depending on which tax zone your property is in.

items.text: Taking bookings before your compliance is settled exposes you to penalties and cancelled reservations, so these checks come before any reservations do.

paragraphs: During peak weeks, back-to-back turnovers leave no slack, so we book cleaning crews before the rush, and local partners clean and walk through your property after every stay. Those routine checks cover outdoor fixtures exposed to salt air, because corrosion caught late turns a small problem into a larger repair and a poor review. We approve any repair up to USD 300 per job without asking you.

Beach and downtown properties compete in a crowded field, so we adjust your rates up to 3 times a day against nearby listings. Strict noise and neighbor rules also shape how you host, so we set quiet hours and guest limits in your house rules.

One more rule shapes your calendar: as of November 2026, San Diego's [STRO Ordinance](https://www.sandiego.gov/treasurer/short-term-residential-occupancy) doesn't allow renting for 21 to 89 days a year, so we keep your calendar below or above that range.

items.question: How much do summer air conditioning and pool costs in Scottsdale take out of my off-season rental income?
items.answer: It comes down to your pool's size, how hard your air conditioning runs and your utility rates. Scottsdale's tiered water rates charge more per unit the more water you use, and the city's [water conservation guidance](https://www.scottsdaleaz.gov/water/water-conservation/water-conservation-for-homeowners) puts a 400 sq. ft. pool's evaporation at about 19,665 gallons a year, mostly in summer. items.question: What do monsoon storms and dust storms do to a rental that sits empty between bookings, and how should it be prepared?
items.answer: Monsoon rains bring flash flooding to your rental. [Maricopa County's monsoon guidance](https://www.maricopa.gov/5557/Monsoon) says sandbags filled 1/2 to 2/3 full and stacked in a brick pattern at doors and low entrances give it temporary protection.

items.question: Do most Scottsdale HOAs and gated communities allow nightly rentals, or do they set minimum stays I'd have to follow?
items.answer: Your own Scottsdale HOA's rules decide whether your home allows nightly rentals and which rental restrictions you have to follow. As of November 2026, [state law doesn't stop HOAs](https://www.scottsdaleaz.gov/codes-and-ordinances/vacation-and-short-term-rentals/information-about-vacation-short-term-rentals) from regulating or restricting short-term rentals. If you read those rules before you buy or list, you know which rental strategy is open to your home. Where short stays are restricted, stays of 30 days or longer are an alternative only if the HOA's rules allow them.

items.question: Would I do better renting to snowbirds by the month in winter than taking short nightly stays?
items.answer: With month-long stays, you give up the higher nightly rates of peak and event weeks in exchange for fewer turnovers and no city short-term rental license. Your HOA's rules decide which strategy you can use. blocks.heading: Nashville Permits, Taxes and Rental Rules
paragraphs: As of November 2026, these are Nashville's requirements; the linked Metro Nashville pages hold the official rules:

items.heading: Operating permit
items.text: You need a [Metro Codes operating permit](https://www.nashville.gov/departments/codes/short-term-rentals) for your short-term rental. It is separate from the business licensing that depends on your income.

items.heading: Under $3,000
items.text: If your rental's annual gross income is under $3,000, you don't need a [business tax license](https://www.nashville.gov/departments/county-clerk/business-services/short-term-rental-property-business-license).

items.heading: $3,000 to $99,999
items.text: At this level of annual gross income, you need a [Minimal Activity license](https://www.nashville.gov/departments/county-clerk/business-services/short-term-rental-property-business-license), which costs $15/$30 a year.

items.heading: $100,000 or more
items.text: At this level, you need a [Business Tax License](https://www.nashville.gov/departments/county-clerk/business-services/short-term-rental-property-business-license) with a one-time $15/$30 fee, and you file TDOR returns and pay the taxes.

items.heading: Tax responsibility
items.text: As the permit holder, you [remit business, sales and hotel occupancy taxes](https://www.nashville.gov/departments/codes/short-term-rentals/use-and-occupancy-taxes) to the city and state. That includes any occupancy and sales taxes the platforms don't collect or remit.

items.heading: Stay limits
items.text: [These rules](https://www.nashville.gov/departments/codes/short-term-rentals) put no yearly cap on rental days. Each stay lasts at least twenty-four hours and no more than thirty consecutive days.

items.heading: Income checks
items.text: We advise you to confirm your license tier before you take bookings and to reassess it as your revenue grows. The licensing duties stay with you.

Frequently Asked Questions

items.question: Can I run a short-term rental in a Nashville home I rent instead of own, and is my landlord's written permission enough?
items.answer: A [2017 Metro Nashville audit of the permit program](https://filetransfer.nashville.gov/Portals/0/SiteContent/InternalAudit/docs/FY2018/20170830CodesShortTermRentalProgram.pdf) says you can apply as a lessee for a multifamily (Type III) short-term rental permit, for example for an apartment or condominium, and that your application must include signed documentation showing the owner's permission. Confirm the current rule with Metro Codes before you apply.

items.question: If my permit lapses or I sell the house, can a non-owner-occupied permit be issued again for that address in my zone?
items.answer: As of November 2026, no new [non-owner-occupied short-term rental permits](https://www.nashville.gov/departments/codes/short-term-rentals/permit-types) are issued in AR2A, R, RS or RM zones. You can renew an existing permit in those zones, but it ends when the property is sold or transferred, and it doesn't carry over to the buyer. Check the property's zoning and permit status before you buy.

items.question: Does a typical homeowner's policy in Nashville cover tornado or flood damage while guests are staying there?
items.answer: Not reliably. Tennessee's insurance regulator [noted in December 2023](https://www.tn.gov/commerce/news/2023/12/13/tdci-shares-tips-on-how-to-file-insurance-claims-hire-contractors-and-ensure-home-safety-as-part-of-tornado-recovery-.html) that most standard homeowners' policies cover storm damage from wind, wind-driven rain, trees or other falling objects. Whether flood damage is covered, and whether any cover applies while paying guests stay, depends on your own policy. Before go-live, we ask for a policy that explicitly covers short-term rental use with paying guests, so ask your insurer to confirm in writing that it covers tornado and flood damage during a stay.
